text: Teaching Objectives After graduation, you will be qualified as senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprise trade, administrative management, training, and other fields. Main Courses Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Fluid Mechanics, Fundamentals of Materials Engineering, Engineering Drawing, Fundamentals of Mechanical Design, Electrotechnics and Electronic Techniques, Computer Program Design, and Control Engineering, Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics Duration 4 years Internship Metalworking, mechanical drafting, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, comprehensive practice in computer measurement and control technology, professional practice, professional design, graduation design, etc. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Future Career After graduation, you can work as a comprehensive senior engineer to design mechatronics systems, manufacture or develop new technology in enterprises or research institutes. You can also pursue further studies in the major at a university.
